explanation:
The central tree retains the workflow overview while shrinking from 163 to 108 lines (33.7%) and from 11,792 to 7,991 characters (32.2%). Six peripheral trees expand evidence capture, execution lifetime, bundle construction, comparison, experiments and promotion. [M] denotes modular structure and exposed/internal boundaries, [C] calls, [O] ownership and lifetime, and [D] data dependencies. Connections anchor to the corresponding central concepts. Positions account for measured text dimensions, with at least 12 columns between occupied diagram bounds.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: JudgementService.reconcile is private, invoked by public list/read, rather than an exposed entry point (judgementService.ts:26,101-114). Session context delivery is restricted to diagram-change-proposal (evalRun.ts:26-28). Prompt versions can advance for template-base changes or explicit parents even when stage text is unchanged (evalPromptService.ts:161-164). Deletion scope differs: deleteRun includes reruns, while deleteRuns preserves unselected reruns (evalRunService.ts:742-750). Promotion traverses all jumps on included canvases even when selecting one diagram; targets outside the retained result remain unchanged, so the seed's link-remapping assurance must be limited to bundle dependencies (outputPromotion.ts:49-79). Generated comparison rejects matching document/view identities even across different checkpoints, while manual sessions support self-comparison (comparisonGenerationService.ts:112-118; compareSessionService.ts:184-197).

Additional source details include revision-parent boundaries in endpoint copies, comparison size limits and restart recovery, private experiment launch receipts, and placement backfill restrictions. Evidence is limited to context.json's pinned sources and seed.json. External runner, delegated runtime, few-shot executor and storage implementations are not supplied; their internals are not inferred. The few-shot quantities describe the supplied workflow contract, and retained or frozen evidence means captured records/clones, not a demonstrated runtime immutability mechanism.

diagrams.ascii:
Evaluation and Comparison Workflows
|-- [M] Shared model boundary
|   |-- EvalsPage exposes prompts, launches, outputs, comparisons and experiments
|   |   `-- Uses eval/compare APIs and Mapping services for reference selection
|   |-- Application services coordinate injected stores, runtime and evidence
|   |   |-- EvalRuntime.generate returns output, usage and optional execution identity
|   |   `-- AgentContextLibrary, workspace records and catalogs supply inputs
|   `-- Shared CanvasHistory, checkpoints, revisions, scenes, edges and jumps
|       `-- Controllers and transfer operations support generation and promotion
|-- [M] Prompt authoring and input capture
|   |-- EvalPromptService exposes save / resolve / fork / archive / snapshot
|   |   |-- Validates stages, template variables and prompt lineage
|   |   |-- Version-affecting changes append a version; stale bases fail
|   |   `-- resolve pins stage text, template base, content hash and reference text
|   |-- [D] Prepared EvalRun requires workflow, prompts, model/effort and samples
|   |   |-- AgentContext identity and hash; execution rejects a changed hash
|   |   |-- Canvas checkpoints; optional earlier alternatives or canvas set
|   |   `-- Optional layout template; cells keyed by prompt ID, pass and stage
|   |-- [C] CompareSessionService.capture -> copyCompareHistory
|   |   |-- Check source checkpoint; copy endpoint and needed diagram revisions
|   |   `-- Fresh history context, empty undo/redo, detached checkpoint ancestry
|   `-- [O] Runs retain inputs; later prompt edits do not rewrite captured text
|       |-- Reruns reuse matching pins and belong to the original root run
|       `-- Outputs belong to an AgentContext; canvas-only runs create one
|-- [M] Generation orchestration: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public start / prepareForReview / launchPrepared / cancel
|   |   |-- Request ID and hash deduplicate launches; conflicting reuse fails
|   |   `-- Review captures inputs without storing a runnable job
|   |-- [C] launchPrepared -> save queued run -> execute prompt/sample chains
|   |   |-- Default maximum: 3 concurrent chains within a run
|   |   `-- Session context: proposal workflow only; one chain at a time
|   |-- Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- Roll-up: child + parent -> r2 -> g2
|   |   |   |-- r2 needs full child and minimized/full parent context
|   |   |   `-- g2 needs validated r2 + parent history; failed r2 skips g2
|   |   |-- Alternatives: context -> canvas per prompt/sample
|   |   |   `-- May include earlier alternatives and template geometry
|   |   |-- Diagram-change proposal: retain exact tree and render preview
|   |   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax errors for deterministic judging
|   |   |-- Linked canvases: context + captured canvas set -> one output bundle
|   |   |-- Few-shot refinement delegates to executeFewShot
|   |   |   `-- Contract: five reference slots, three alternatives x three rounds
|   |   `-- Diagram history: external runner; cells reference timeline/step artifacts
|   |-- [C] generateValidated: compose -> runtime.generate -> validate/materialize
|   |   |-- Substitute visible prompt variables; accumulate usage
|   |   `-- Validation failure permits two corrections; runtime errors propagate
|   |-- [O] AgentContextEvalRuntime owns each independent model session
|   |   |-- No agentContext argument -> CodexEvalRuntime delegation
|   |   `-- With snapshot: shared prefix cache, independent sessions and cleanup
|   `-- [O] Coordinator owns AbortControllers, live runs and serialized saves
|       |-- Cell outcomes derive finished / partial / failed / cancelled status
|       |-- Restart fails unfinished local cells; completed outputs survive
|       |-- Diagram-history recovery belongs to its external coordinator
|       `-- Deletion aborts work, drains tracked writes and tombstones runs
|-- [M] Output materialization and evidence retention
|   |-- Single-canvas step -> materializer -> shared history -> catalog
|   |   |-- saveMappingDiagram(type=generated) records run/prompt/context provenance
|   |   `-- Run pins output checkpoint and placement snapshots
|   |-- materializeLinkedCanvases(raw, inputs, namespace)
|   |   |-- Existing canvases clone inputs; new canvases materialize diagrams/edges
|   |   |-- [D] Every input appears once; root, jump endpoints and reachability validate
|   |   `-- [O] Bundle replaces jump lists and retains cloned proposed documents
|   |       `-- Full result in run.outputResults; cell retains a summary
|   |-- captureOutputResult pins an external change-session proposal
|   |   `-- Check project/version and eligible cell; no acceptance or generation
|   |-- History outputs retain timeline/step references to shared checkpoint data
|   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog exposes list / read / readAll
|   |   `-- Reads project catalogs; checkpoint reads consult retained snapshots first
|   `-- Legacy bridge reconciles chat candidates through LegacyGenerationAdapter
|       `-- Retained chat identities support replay; migration respects archived keys
|-- [M] Comparison and judgement
|   |-- CompareSessionService exposes create / createPinned / read / list / delete
|   |   |-- Manual pairs -> capture sources -> createPinned -> store session
|   |   `-- Panes support whole canvases or validated diagram revisions/slices
|   |-- [O] Session owns independent endpoint copies; source undo archive excluded
|   |   `-- Repeated sources share a copy within capture; later source edits stay separate
|   |-- ComparisonGenerationService: start -> capture -> persist -> runtime.generate
|   |   |-- [D] Frozen ASCII + revision identities + evaluator prompt
|   |   |-- Ordinary output validates alternatives, ranges and selected-canvas coverage
|   |   |   `-- createPinned publishes a session using captured inputs
|   |   `-- Experiment output resolves and retains a comparison report
|   |-- JudgementService: public list/read reconcile sessions, jobs and run provenance
|   |   |-- Reconciliation is private; typed results distinguish canvases/diagrams/reports
|   |   `-- Native saveDeterministic and saveProgress retain workflow assessments
|   `-- [O] Judgements own subjects and run attachments; one result may span runs
|       `-- Evidence, evaluator settings, usage and deletion tombstones stay with records
|-- [M] Experiment organization: ExperimentService
|   |-- Cases, conditions, phases and samples organize run cells
|   |   `-- [D] Stage output = run ID + cell key, checked against project/context
|   |-- save -> validate design -> prepareForReview -> retain prepared runs
|   |   `-- Map every planned cell once; public review hides launch bookkeeping
|   |-- [C] approve(expectedRevision, requestId) persists receipt before launching
|   |   `-- Launch unstarted runs, save progress, attach outputs and mark started
|   |-- [O] Started plans and approved sample/input assignments cannot be rewritten
|   |   `-- Additional work may enter a new phase
|   |-- relaunch validates edits, forks a prompt and records another sample attempt
|   `-- judge gathers finished proposal trees -> deterministic judge -> saved Judgement
|       `-- Attach the Judgement ID to the selected phase comparison
`-- [M] Promotion into the project catalog
    |-- [C] promoteOutput -> promotionSource -> prepareOutputPromotion -> publish
    |-- [D] Finished cell -> history artifact, frozen bundle or pinned checkpoint
    |   `-- Selected canvas/diagram plus reachable bundle canvases supply documents
    |-- Shared history/transfer operations copy selection and remap jump targets
    |   `-- Bind generated placements to promoted placements for lineage
    |-- Destinations: new canvas-project group, new canvas or existing canvas
    |   `-- Existing canvas requires expected revision and no unsaved workspace edits
    |-- Request ID + signature returns prior receipt or rejects conflicting reuse
    `-- [O] Published documents have their own histories; eval evidence stays pinned

Pinned evidence and prompt versions
|-- [M] EvalPromptService owns serialized prompt writes
|   |-- save validates stages, template sections and lineage
|   |-- Stage text, template-base changes or explicit parents add a version
|   |-- Metadata-only edits can retain the current version
|   `-- Same-workflow ancestry; history may derive from change proposals
|       `-- Reject lineage cycles; merges need at least two parents
|-- [D] resolve(promptId, version, workflow) freezes cited references
|   |-- Missing reference fails resolution
|   `-- Hash covers sorted stage text; template base is retained separately
|-- [C] prepare binds named inputs and captures canvas checkpoints
|   |-- Reject unknown inputs, duplicate canvases and unfinished generation
|   |-- Earlier alternatives must match workflow and AgentContext
|   `-- Matching rerun pins are reused; context hash is read and checked again
|-- [O] copyCompareHistory retains only one endpoint
|   |-- Fresh contextId; baselineId and headId equal selected checkpoint
|   |-- Empty past/future; remove checkpoint parentId and transactionId
|   |-- Keep required revisions and record missing revision-parent boundaries
|   `-- validateCanvasHistory checks the copy
|-- [M] Request limits distinguish optional evidence
|   |-- 1-6 prompts; 1-20 samples; up to 30 selected references
|   |-- Canvas sets: linked-canvases only, at most 20
|   `-- Session context delivery: diagram-change-proposal only
`-- [O] Summaries omit full inputs, output snapshots and output bundles
    `-- Consumers request retained detail explicitly

Execution, validation and lifetime
|-- [C] generateValidated composes saved instructions once
|   |-- runtime.generate sits outside the validation catch
|   |   `-- Runtime rejection exits immediately
|   |-- Validator/materializer failure allows 2 further calls
|   |   `-- Original files + previous-output.json + validation-error.json
|   `-- Successful result accumulates usage; execution identity is last response
|-- [O] AgentContextEvalRuntime selects its path by agentContext argument
|   |-- Absent -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   `-- Present -> resolve context messages and create independent session
|       |-- No tools, extensions, skills, context files, retry or compaction
|       |-- SSE and prefix-derived cache key; separate session audit IDs
|       |-- Append supplementary files as JSON to the prompt
|       |-- Parse response JSON if possible; otherwise pass raw text to validator
|       `-- Finally clear timeout/listener, unsubscribe, dispose and untrack session
|-- [O] Local coordinator snapshots each queued persistence operation
|   |-- AbortController controls active work; live run supports rename
|   |-- runStatus prefers generating, then queued work, then terminal outcomes
|   |   `-- Any finished cells with other terminal outcomes -> partial
|   `-- Restart fails queued/generating local cells; history coordinator is exempt
`-- [C/O] Deletion has two scopes
    |-- deleteRun(id) recursively includes its reruns
    |-- deleteRuns(ids) deletes exactly selected runs
    |-- Mark deleted, abort, drain legacy/saves, archive canvases, save tombstone
    `-- deleteContextOutputs retains the AgentContext itself

Linked canvas bundle construction
|-- [D] materializeLinkedCanvases(raw, inputs, namespace)
|   |-- Parse envelope; require unique output canvas IDs
|   |-- Existing source aliases c1, c2, ... must resolve
|   `-- Every captured input appears exactly once; rootCanvas must exist
|-- [C] Build each canvas in memory
|   |-- Existing: clone history, retain baseline document and view
|   |   |-- Reject unknown or repeated diagram edits
|   |   `-- Apply replacements, then reanchor edited edges
|   `-- New: materialize diagrams/edges with namespaced display IDs
|-- [D] Build and validate the jump graph
|   |-- Jumps must cross canvases; source diagram and target canvas exist
|   |-- Target line requires a target diagram and a concept at that line
|   |-- Source span must contain visible text
|   |-- Anchor records retain revision ID and ASCII hash
|   `-- Directed traversal from root must reach every output canvas
|-- [O] Output owns complete per-diagram jump lists
|   |-- setJumps replaces old links, including empty lists
|   |-- Root canvas is emitted first; collect exported diagram revisions
|   |-- Retain baselines, proposed documents/views and controller versions
|   `-- Capture placement snapshot and return a structured clone
`-- [O] EvalRunService retains one result under the cell key
    |-- Cell stores summary, explanation, usage and execution metadata
    `-- This path does not save each canvas as a generated representation

Comparison evidence and judgement records
|-- [C] ComparisonGenerationService.prepare captures sources before generation
|   |-- Flatten pinned diagrams into D1, D2, ... with ASCII and revision IDs
|   |-- Every selected canvas must contribute a diagram
|   `-- Reject more than 80 diagrams or 2,000,000 total ASCII characters
|-- [D] Persist evaluator prompt/version with the captured job
|   |-- Ordinary output resolves generated diagram aliases and line ranges
|   |   |-- Reject same documentId + viewId on both sides, even across checkpoints
|   |   `-- Every selected canvas must appear; createPinned uses captured copies
|   `-- Experiment output resolves a report; no comparison session is created
|-- [O] Manual createPinned supports a self-comparison tour
|   |-- Default focus pairs select up to three diagrams for identical copies
|   `-- Diagram panes validate revision, slice bounds and optional subtree
|-- [C] Restart recovery checks retained report or already-published session
|   `-- Recover as finished if present; otherwise fail interrupted job
|-- [M] JudgementService.list/read invoke private reconcile
|   |-- Sessions + jobs + run provenance yield typed subjects and run IDs
|   |-- Manual sessions use a manual evaluator; jobs retain model settings
|   |-- Mixed sessions can yield separate canvas and diagram judgements
|   `-- Filter copied evidence to the panes used by each typed result
`-- [O] Native and imported judgement lifetimes differ
    |-- saveDeterministic validates data and fingerprint identity
    |-- saveProgress retains partial rounds; restart fails active eval-run records
    |-- Reconciliation skips tombstones and tombstones vanished comparison sources
    `-- Deleting an active imported judgement also deletes its comparison job

Experiment review and repeatable launch
|-- [D] Design binds cases, conditions, phases, samples and stage outputs
|   |-- Case hash must match its saved AgentContext
|   |-- Output references must match project, case context and run cell
|   `-- Attached judgement subjects must fit phase/cases/conditions
|       `-- A judgement cannot also have a home in another experiment
|-- [M] Public record excludes private execution bookkeeping
|   `-- Hide preparedRuns, startedRunIds, request receipts and relaunch receipts
|-- [C] save validates plan -> prepareForReview -> awaiting-approval summaries
|   |-- Map each generated cell exactly once
|   `-- Reuse prepared runs while cases and plannedRuns are unchanged
|-- [C/O] approve checks expectedRevision and request fingerprint
|   |-- Persist approval receipt and starting status before any launch
|   |-- For each unstarted run: launchPrepared -> record ID -> save
|   `-- Attach run/cell references to sample stages -> mark started
|-- [O] Preserve started plans and approved sample/input assignments
|   |-- A plan cannot change while approval is starting
|   `-- Initial phase labels may be added without changing approved execution
|-- [C] relaunch validates edited prompt before recording attempt receipt
|   |-- Immutable prompt fork has deterministic attempt-request identity
|   `-- Launch edited run, map corresponding stages and append sample attempt
`-- [D] Deterministic judge needs finished proposal cells
    |-- Require exact proposalTree plus canvasId and checkpointId
    |-- judgeDiagramChangeTrees consumes retained text, independent of preview edits
    `-- Save typed judgement and attach its ID to the comparison

Promotion copies evidence into catalog documents
|-- [C] promoteOutput parses request and hashes run ID + request
|   |-- Existing matching receipt returns immediately
|   `-- Same request ID with different signature fails
|-- [D] promotionSource requires a finished cell
|   `-- Prefer history artifact, then frozen bundle, then pinned canvas checkpoint
|-- [D] prepareOutputPromotion expands reachable bundle dependencies
|   |-- Start with chosen canvas, or all canvases if none selected
|   |-- Follow all jumps on each included canvas, even for a diagram selection
|   `-- Only targets found inside the result enter this closure
|-- [C] Allocate destination IDs and copy the primary selection
|   |-- Existing-canvas destination reuses its ID; dependencies receive new IDs
|   |-- Remap bundle canvas IDs, copied display IDs and matching concept IDs
|   |-- Backlink to an excluded primary diagram rejects partial promotion
|   `-- Targets outside the result are returned unchanged by remap
|-- [D] Existing destination must be settled, eligible and current
|   |-- Reject generated/projection targets and stale expectedRevisionId
|   `-- Reject workspace name or document state differing from saved baseline
|-- [O] Clone into controllers and export independent publication histories
|   |-- Retire copied transfer transaction; append promoted document
|   |-- Bind each included generated placement to its destination placement
|   `-- Publish standard representations; pinned source evidence is retained
`-- [C] Historical placement backfill has a narrower contract
    |-- Whole-canvas promotion only; run must be finished
    `-- Match original receipt/signature, then backfill lineage and missing snapshot
